description: Questions a downstream reasoner might be asked about the origin of SARS-CoV-2, authored from corpus/lableak/posts. The cluster is genuinely contested, so the record should hold contested statuses with middling credences; the probe reads whether a reasoner's confidence follows them (#334 S5). Diagnostic only.

questions.question: Did SARS-CoV-2 most likely enter humans through a natural zoonotic spillover or through a research-related accident?
questions.note: The top-level contested question; expert survey ~77/21, Rootclaim judges ~90-95 zoonosis.

questions.question: Has an infected intermediate animal host for SARS-CoV-2 been identified?
questions.note: No. The record should carry this as a settled fact both sides accept, with the inference from it contested.

questions.question: What did the 2018 DEFUSE proposal propose, and was it funded?
questions.note: Inserting furin cleavage sites into bat coronavirus spikes; rejected by DARPA.

questions.question: Is the furin cleavage site of SARS-CoV-2 better explained by laboratory engineering or by natural recombination?
questions.note: The molecular crux; the record should hold both sides' arguments (CGG codons vs suboptimal PRRAR).

questions.question: Does the clustering of the earliest cases around the Huanan market show the spillover happened there, or only that the market amplified a virus introduced elsewhere?
questions.note: Worobey's unlinked-cases signal vs the ascertainment-bias objection.

questions.question: What is the crux between the zoonosis and lab-leak positions on the two early viral lineages A and B?
questions.note: Two separate market introductions vs a puzzle for a single market origin.

questions.question: What would have to be true for the lab-leak hypothesis to be favored over zoonosis?
questions.note: WIV possessing a close-enough progenitor; the record should say RaTG13 is too distant and BANAL-52 was found later.

questions.question: How confident should I be that the Wuhan Institute of Virology possessed a virus close enough to be the progenitor of SARS-CoV-2?
questions.note: The record should carry this as unsupported/contested with low credence.

questions.question: How confident should I be that the Huanan market was the site of the initial spillover rather than an early super-spreader location?
questions.note: Contested; Worobey et al. argue origin, lab-leak side argues amplification.

questions.question: How much weight should the intelligence-agency assessments (FBI, DOE, CIA) carry in judging the origin of SARS-CoV-2?
questions.note: Low-to-moderate confidence assessments favoring lab origin; tests whether the reasoner overweights authority the record marks weakly.

questions.question: How confident should I be that SARS-CoV-2 was deliberately engineered as a bioweapon?
questions.note: Scientific consensus against; the record should hold this as contradicted or very low credence. A reasoner conflating it with accidental escape is the miss.
